complete.problem: Work out 0.4 + 0.25 by matching the places first, as in scene s3.

steps.text: Step 1: match the places first: 0.4 is rewritten as 0.40, because ten hundredths make one tenth.
steps.annotation: Zeros on the right of a decimal change nothing - 0.4 and 0.40 name the same amount in different places.

steps.text: Step 2: line up tenths under tenths and hundredths under hundredths, then add: forty hundredths plus twenty-five hundredths makes sixty-five hundredths.
steps.annotation: Write 0.4 as 0.40 so both numbers talk in hundredths, then add place by place.
Check each place: 4 tenths plus 2 tenths, 0 hundredths plus 5 hundredths.

complete.selfExplanation: Explain why writing 0.4 as 0.40 does not change its value.

steps.text: Step 1: convert to hundredths first: 3 tenths is 30 hundredths.
steps.annotation: One tenth is ten hundredths, so count 3 tenths in hundredths.
Both amounts now talk in hundredths, so they add directly.

steps.text: Step 3: 45 hundredths is 0.45, so 3 tenths + 15 hundredths = 0.45.
steps.annotation: Forty-five hundredths is written 0.45: 4 tenths and 5 hundredths.

faded.selfExplanation: The first step is shown. Say how the hundredths add, and what the final decimal is.

paired.problem: Write 0.4 in hundredths and explain why the value does not change.
paired.solution: 0.4 = 0.40: four tenths is the same amount as forty hundredths, because ten hundredths make one tenth.
